description.zh: 汇聚多维警情数据，自动挖掘高发时空规律，一键生成研判报告辅助精准防控。
description.en: Fuse multi-dimensional incident data, mine temporal-spatial patterns and generate analysis reports for targeted prevention.

welcome_message.zh: 提供警情数据，我来挖掘高发规律并生成研判报告
welcome_message.en: Provide incident data — I'll mine patterns and draft the analysis report

description.zh: 输入：警情记录数据（时间、地点、类型等维度）。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 analysis.md（研判报告）与 patterns.html（时空规律图表）
description.en: Input: incident records (time, location, type). Output: analysis.md (report) and patterns.html (pattern charts) under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请对以下警情数据做智能研判。

警情数据（含时间、地点、警情类型等字段）：

研判重点（高发时段/区域/类型）：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 analysis.md（高发时空规律、趋势分析与精准防控建议）和 patterns.html（时空分布可视化图表）。数据不足时使用明确标注的演示数据并说明局限，不虚构统计结论。
prompt.en:
Please analyze the following incident data.

Incident data (time, location, incident type):

Focus (peak hours/areas/types):

Expected output: analysis.md (temporal-spatial patterns, trends and targeted prevention advice) and patterns.html (distribution charts) under outbound/<task>/. Use clearly labeled demo data when data is insufficient and state limitations; never fabricate statistics.
